t: Poanes yehl - Wikipedia
s: October 21, 2024 - Poanes yehl, the Yehl skipper, is a butterfly of the family Hesperiidae. It is found from southeastern Virginia west to southwestern Missouri and south to eastern Texas, the Gulf Coast and northern Florida. The wingspan is 34–45 mm. The upperside is bright orange with wide dark borders.
